messages:
morgan: During onboarding demo I noticed the JS/Python sampleapps sometimes surface broken JSON if you kill the client mid-stream. Likely partial SSE events emitted on shutdown.
tess: Can you share a tiny repro and logs?
morgan: Repro: start sample, trigger long gen, ctrl+c ~200ms after tokens start. Logs: [debug] recv: data: {"text":" He"
[debug] SIGINT
[debug] flush-> "llo"
[error] JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of input

alejandra: Parser finalize() emits leftover buffer even without full 

 delimiter. If auth refresh/reconnect happens concurrently we can get duplicate halves.
tess: Fix plan: 1) Parser: on finalize only emit when buffer has full SSE event; else drop and debug-log. 2) Sampleapps: add gracefulShutdown that polls parser.inFlight up to 150ms before closing. 3) Demo env var DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false to avoid crashing instructor demos. 4) Catch JSON.parse errors and show "Stream ended early; partial output omitted."
ci-bot: created task #4981: add parser tests for mid-chunk abort and auth-reconnect interleaving.
morgan: I'll open small PRs for parser and both sampleapps and link this thread. Please tag @tess for review.
